claims: The 21st-century Great Recession officially ended in 2009.
The average monthly rent for the unfurnished apartments built in 2010 is $3198.50.
The average monthly rent for the furnished apartments built in 2010, excluding those that are only semi-furnished, is $3172.38
The unfurnished apartments built in 2010 have a higher average monthly rent compared to the furnished apartments built in 2010, excluding those that are only semi-furnished.
